university: Tunku Abdul Rahman University of Management and Technology
program_name: Bachelor of Communication (Honours) in Media Studies

fees.notes: TAR UMT official programme page lists RM74,400 as the total international fee for the full programme (inclusive of 6% SST; covers all fees payable to TAR UMT, excluding EMGS and immigration charges; the page states fees may vary by 10%). Source: https://fcci.tarc.edu.my/programmes/bachelor-degree/media-studies (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: (1) STPM - Grade C in 2 relevant subjects (2) A Level - Grade D in 2 relevant subjects (3) UEC - Grade B in 5 relevant subjects (4) Other IHL - Relevant Foundation/ Diploma accredited by MQA (5) TAR UC - Foundation in Arts (Track C) or Relevant Diploma Compulsory subject: (1), (2), (3) and (4) must include SPM Credit/ O Level Grade C/ UEC Grade B in English Language Note: a) Students without a credit in SPM Bahasa Melayu are required to pass Bahasa Kebangsaan A before the award of Bachelor Degree. b) TAR UC Diploma will be accepted on credit transfer into Bachelor Degree programmes. c) Equivalent qualifications/qualifications from other Institution of Higher Learning (IHL) will be considered on a case-by-case basis. d) Subject to the Ministry of Higher Education latest requirements.
